rows.grounds: conjunction continuing the list of placement locations
qualifies the arm as the left one
locative noun denoting the site of placement
inclusive particle extending the placement to this location
indicates the same manner of placement as previously stated

items.question: Must the same manner of ritual placement extend to the left arm as well?
premises: The preceding instructions specify placement at facial locations.
The verse adds the left arm as a location.
The verse marks this addition as performed in the same manner.
items.inference: The same manner of placement is also to be performed on the left arm.
uncertainties: Whether īdṛśaṃ functions adverbially or qualifies an implied object is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: And also in the left arm, in the same manner.
